independent_computation.metric_under_test: per_rank_DPS(slot, rank) = total_raw(rank, AP) / effective_cooldown(rank, ability_haste), with effective_cooldown = base_cd * 100/(100+AH) for CDR-affected abilities

pinned_vs_free_slots.pinned: Q (Dark Sphere) is a setup slot, not a free slot: W 'grabs the nearest Dark Sphere', E knocks Dark Spheres back for the 1.25s stun, and R 'additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones'. Every other Syndra slot consumes the resource Q creates, so Q precedes them by a detected setup/consume edge rather than by DPS.
pinned_vs_free_slots.free: W, E, R (plus the Q2 charge slot, which shares Q's row and the same setup edge)

independent_computation.matrix_swept: levels 1..18 x AP {0,50,...,1000} x ability haste {0,10,...,100} = 4158 cells; ranks allocated by the standard Q>W>E max order with R at 6/11/16

results.W_beats_E: 3388 / 3388 cells where both exist (100%). No violations at any rank pair, any AP, any haste.
results.E_vs_R_at_the_7_sphere_maximum: 308 / 3003 cells violate, all at AP below the rank-matched crossover: AP<23.5 for (E1 vs R1), AP<79.5 for (E2 vs R2), AP<29.6 for (E5 vs R3). Every one of these is below the AP a mid Syndra holds at the level where that R rank exists, so no reachable matrix cell reorders.
results.W_transcendent_row_check: using the 60-splinter Total Mixed Damage row for W instead of the plain magic row, min(W - E) over the whole matrix = +2.533 DPS, i.e. W still strictly ahead everywhere.
results.free_slot_order: W > E > R, invariant over the entire swept matrix.

independent_computation.why_the_invariance_is_structural: W, E and R are all affectedByCdr=true, so effective_cooldown scales every one of them by the identical factor 100/(100+AH). Ability haste is therefore a common positive scalar on the whole free-slot ranking and cancels out of every pairwise comparison. What remains is a comparison of affine-in-AP numerators over fixed base cooldowns, and W's AP slope per second (0.65/(13-r), min 0.0542) strictly dominates E's (0.60/15 = 0.0400), which strictly dominates R's (<=0.0175). Both the intercepts and the slopes are ordered the same way, so no crossover exists for AP >= 0. That is the mathematical content of 'consistent across the matrix'.

assessment.formula_named_is_the_projects_own: The string cites total_raw / effective cooldown, which is verbatim the F3 free-slot signal specified in data/worklists/f3-task.md 1.b, and effective cooldown is the cd*100/(100+AH) operator certified EXACT in docs/math-foundations.md line 462.
assessment.claim_of_consistency_is_true_for_syndra: Verified over 4158 matrix cells. The free-slot order is W > E > R with no reordering anywhere reachable.
assessment.old_value_absent_was_a_gap_not_a_correct: The rotation's sources list is the rationale/provenance chain for the derived order; with the entry absent, the free-slot ranking step of the derivation carried no provenance even though it is the step that fixed W before E before R. Adding it makes a true and load-bearing statement, so the new value is correct and the old (absent) state was incomplete.

caveats_flagged_not_defects.note: f3-task.md 1.b writes the signal as 'total_raw / effective cooldown x AoE weight'; the rationale string drops the AoE-weight factor. Immaterial for Syndra: Q (spellEffects 'Aoe'), W ('damage to them and nearby enemies') and E (cone) are all AoE while R barrages a single champion, so any AoE weight >= 1 on the AoE slots only pushes R further down and preserves W > E > R. Worth confirming the same holds for single-target champions elsewhere in the matrix.

data/champions.json marks Syndra Q affectedByCdr=false (it is a rechargeRate 7 charge ability). If Q were ever scored as a free slot with a haste-exempt cooldown, the invariance claim would fail: with Q pinned at 7s while W scales by 100/(100+AH), W overtakes Q at roughly 30-40 ability haste (1201 of 4158 swept cells). Q is correctly outside the free set because it is the setup slot every other Syndra ability consumes, so the leaf's claim survives - but the claim is only true because Q is excluded. Scoring Q with the same haste operator as the rest removes the flip entirely (0 violations).

data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json records an r_spheres option. At the 3-sphere baseline R is unambiguously last everywhere. At the 7-sphere maximum, R outranks E only below ~24-80 AP depending on rank pair - unreachable in practice, but the invariance margin there is thin (at level 18 / 0 AP the gap is 14.00 vs 13.33) and would be worth re-checking if the R minimum-sphere default ever changes.
